title: Core: AS2 Array constructor and initialization
description: Test compilation of Array construction: new Array(), new Array(5), new Array('a','b','c'), var arr = [], var arr = [1,2,3]. Test Array.from-like patterns. Verify ActionInitArray (0x36) for array literal, ActionNew (0x4a) for constructor. Test nested array literals: [[1,2],[3,4]]. Test array access: arr[0], arr[arr.length-1].
